description: Golden prompts for the Colabonate Assistant (plan docs/plans/Plan_ai-assistant-ux-output-prompt-review.md, Phase 4). Run against the production model (DeepSeek) after every system-prompt change. See README.md in this folder.

criteria.tools: The tool names the assistant is expected to call (in any order). Empty array = must not call a write tool.
criteria.mustConfirm: true = the answer must summarize the action and ask for an explicit yes instead of performing it.
criteria.maxBullets: Maximum bullet count in the prose answer.
criteria.noFabricatedIds: true = no id/pubkey-looking strings in the prose (ids may only appear in rendered cards).

cases.prompt: Show me available offers I can buy
Zeig mir Angebote, die ich kaufen kann
What am I selling right now?
Create an offer for a 30-minute consulting call for 5000 sats
Create and publish an offer for logo design, 20000 sats
Publish my draft offer
Delete my offer titled 'Old Service'
What cooperation possibilities do I have?
Start a new cooperation for a joint podcast
Show my purchase tickets
Is my last ticket paid?
Release the payment for my ticket
Open a dispute on my ticket because nothing was delivered
Show open bounties my agent can apply to
Apply to the first bounty with my research agent
Show the active DAO proposals
Vote FOR the current proposal
